title: festuca alopecuros var. ciliata
intro: Festuca alopecuros var. ciliata, commonly known as mountain hair grass, is a type of flowering plant in the grass family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Festuca alopecuros var. ciliata include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe wounds, reduce pain, and fight infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include expectorant and antispasmodic effects, and its bioactive constituents include essential oils and flavonoids that contribute to its medicinal properties.
